SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.I, Special Branch Station,
File No. ......
REPORT
Date September 21, 1939.

Subject Confidential Communication dated 5-9-39 from Major J.K. Mackintosh
Walker, Commanding Officer, "HQ" Company, 1st Bn., The Seaforth High-
landers, concerning Miss M. Biletoff.
Made by. D.S.I. Prokofiev, Forwarded by. R. W. Macadie D.S.I.

Margarita Anatolievna BILETOFF, Russian, born
on April 24, 1919 at Harbin. She is reported to
have first arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in October,
1928 together with her grandmother, Mrs. O.N. Anders,
mother of Mr. V.L. Anders, formerly principal of a
middle school in Harbin, which was closed in 1928
owing, it is reported, to some irregularities in
conducting the school. Some time later Mrs. Anders
and her granddaughter, who was an orphan, returned to
Harbin where the girl attended a school. In September
1934 Mrs. Anders and Miss Biletoff again arrived in
Shanghai and stayed with Mrs. Beylin, Miss Belitoff's
aunt, at 42 Route Vallon, House 4. It appears that
Mrs. Anders was in very reduced circumstances, as
when she departed to Harbin some time during the
summer, 1935 she was unable to pay her passage and was
helped by the Russian Emigrants Committee. Miss
Biletoff remained in Shanghai and on 9/6/35 married
a Russian named E.V. Glinsky, who at that time served
in the Russian Regiment, S.V.C. The couple resided
at 697/9 Avenue Joffre. During the latter part of
1936 a daughter was born to them. About two years
ago Mrs. Glinsky secured a position as a bar hostess
at the Delconte Bar & Restaurant, 365 Bubbling Well
Road, in which capacity she worked for about 18 months.
It is reported that recently she divorced her husband,
but no official information is available regarding
the date of divorce and the office through the medium

报告
日期：1939年9月21日。

事由：关于比列托夫小姐（Miss M. Biletoff）事宜，转呈海福尔高地人团（The Seaforth Highlanders）第1营“总部”连连长 J.K. 麦金托什·沃克少校（Major J.K. Mackintosh Walker）于1939年9月5日发出的机密函件。
制作人：特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫（D.S.I. Prokofiev），转呈人：特别调查员 R. W. 麦卡迪（R. W. Macadie D.S.I.）。

玛格丽塔·阿纳托利耶芙娜·比列托夫（Margarita Anatolievna BILETOFF），俄罗斯人，1919年4月24日出生于哈尔滨。据报，她于1928年10月与其祖母 O.N. 安德斯夫人（Mrs. O.N. Anders）一同从哈尔滨首次抵达上海。安德斯夫人是 V.L. 安德斯先生（Mr. V.L. Anders）的母亲，后者曾任哈尔滨一所中学校长，该校据报因办学行为存在某些不端之处而于1928年关闭。不久之后，安德斯夫人及其身为孤儿的孙女返回哈尔滨，女孩在当地就读于一所学校。1934年9月，安德斯夫人和比列托夫小姐再次抵达上海，借住在比列托夫小姐的姨妈贝林夫人（Mrs. Beylin）处，地址为华伦路（Route Vallon）42号4室。看来安德斯夫人的境况十分窘迫，因为她在1935年夏季某时启程前往哈尔滨时，无力支付旅费，并得到了俄罗斯移民委员会的资助。比列托夫小姐留在上海，并于1935年6月9日嫁给了一位名为 E.V. 格林斯基（E.V. Glinsky）的俄罗斯人，此人当时在上海义勇军（S.V.C.）俄罗斯团服役。夫妇二人居住在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）697/9号。1936年下半年，他们生下一个女儿。大约两年前，格林斯基夫人在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）365号的德尔孔特酒吧餐厅（Delconte Bar & Restaurant）谋得一份酒吧女招待的职位，在此岗位上工作了约18个月。据报，她最近与丈夫离婚，但关于离婚日期及办理机构尚无官方信息可供查证。

The Commissioner
of the Police.
Shanghai.

Subject: Character,

CONFIDENTIAL
No. S. / 9446
Date 21 9 39

Dear Sir,

Could you please furnish me with information
as to the Character of Miss Margerette Belittova who until recently was
employed in the Delmonico Restaurant, 365 P'Well Road.

Application for marriage to this young woman
has been made by a soldier of my Company.

Shanghai
5/9/39.

J Mackintosh Walker
Major
Commanding "HQ" Company
1st Bn The Seaforth Highlanders

MAJOR J. R. MACKINTOSH-WALKER, M.C.

上海。

事由：品行，

机密
编号 S. / 9446
日期 1939年9月21日

尊敬的先生：

能否请您提供有关玛格丽特·贝利托娃小姐（Miss Margerette Belittova）品行的信息？她最近在静安寺路（P'Well Road）365号的德尔莫尼科餐厅（Delmonico Restaurant）任职。

我连的一名士兵已向这位年轻女子提出结婚申请。

上海
1939年9月5日。

J. 麦金托什·沃克
少校
海福尔高地人团第1营“总部”连连长
